secondary_endpoints: CPU time, five native commands separately, original common-package control and original WASM compilation
profile: Original Cargo.toml profiles and per-package test overrides; CI dev debug=0, incremental=0, jobs=4; no opt-level or codegen-unit override
cold_artifacts: New target directories per compiler/round; five native commands share one initially empty target directory in their original order; common/WASM use separate cold targets
order: Alternate official/optimized first by VM and round; retain every sample
correctness: Execute all four original native cargo test commands for each compiler on each VM after its first block, outside measurement; no test filters or added ignores
primary_contrast: (official Windows minus optimized Windows) / official Windows: practical toolchain replacement, not a new linker-separated PGO/LTO attribution
aggregation: Sum five native command times within each block; average measured rounds within VM; equal-weight VM means
uncertainty: 10000 seeded whole-VM bootstrap draws; preserve Windows compiler pairing; independent Linux resampling; 95% percentile intervals
interpretation: Report native CI savings and intervals against the prior graphics estimate; interval overlap is not proof of equal effects
exclusions: Exclude pilot runs and predetermined warmup blocks; reject incomplete or failed matrices; no slow-sample trimming
scope: Exact original offline compilation workload, not cached production CI, test execution, linting, downloads, uploads or entire job duration
